final: WITH f AS (SELECT raceId, points, wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0), pr AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM f GROUP BY raceId), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall FROM pr) SELECT pr.raceId, pr.avg_points, pr.avg_wins, pr.avg_wins - ov.overall AS diff FROM pr, ov WHERE ov.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
